steps.en: OCMS has already converted the REPCCS advisory notice to a normal notice
steps.id: OCMS sudah mengubah AN REPCCS menjadi notice biasa
steps.why_en: No conversion logic exists in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika konversi di code.

steps.en: OCMS produces a daily report of the converted notices
steps.id: OCMS membuat laporan harian notice yang dikonversi
steps.why_en: Only a screen listing recent advisory notices exists, not a daily report of converted ones.
steps.why_id: Yang ada hanya layar daftar AN terbaru, bukan laporan harian notice yang dikonversi.

steps.en: The report appears on the OIC's staff screen
steps.id: Laporan muncul di layar staff OIC
steps.why_en: It is only a tab in the reports menu; nothing is pushed to a personal dashboard.
steps.why_id: Hanya tab di menu laporan; tidak ada yang dikirim ke dashboard pribadi.

steps.en: The OIC can download the report
steps.why_en: The tab has no download button.
steps.why_id: Tab ini tidak punya tombol unduh.
